write_up: You’ve progressed from object storage at Nimbus Cloud to leading ledger and settlement work at Brightline Payments. A recruiter can follow that path and would likely move your resume forward with a few questions about the size and results of your staff-level work.

The idempotency line is your best model: it connects an initiative across payment services to the duplicate-charge incidents it eliminated. The ledger redesign is technically substantial too, but a recruiter can’t yet tell what changed after the move.

Let’s start with the current Brightline role. Add the team’s size and what changed with the ledger redesign, then give the multi-currency roadmap a little more of your own contribution. The older reconciliation result is worth expanding too.

cards.line: - Led the redesign of the core ledger service from a monolithic Postgres-backed system to a horizontally scalable event-sourced architecture on Kafka and CockroachDB
cards.cannot_tell: The architecture change is clear, but the reason for it and what changed afterward are missing. Those details would show a recruiter why the redesign mattered to payments.
